body:
Founder: 'ok northstar this for anticheat' after a real research conversation on hardware-level USB HID input cheats. Grounded the plan directly in SHANKPIT's own real architecture: fully server-authoritative combat (a hardware cheat can only steer aim, never fabricate damage/kills), raw UserCmd yaw/pitch already flowing through process_user_cmd at 60Hz (Phase 0 telemetry needs no protocol change), the existing bot-pool infrastructure (bots are genuine connected UDP clients), and S459-62's own active-opponent precedent as reusable groundwork. Captured the founder's own real design: silent reroute on suspicion into a bot-only match, an escalating bot ladder culminating in sub-human-reaction-time impossible bots (a physically-grounded, near-unfakeable signal), bounded-cost outcomes so even false positives are safe. Real gaps named: CV-only/memory-reading cheats are a different threat class. NORTHSTAR only, no code. Commit 44e8195.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-75: added ANTICHEAT_NORTHSTAR.md -- real, phased anti-cheat design scoping
